description.en: Cups of coffee drunk. A widely cited industry order-of-magnitude figure (~2.25 billion cups a day); spread by GDP share as a rough purchasing-power proxy.
description.it: Tazze di caffè bevute. Un ordine di grandezza molto citato dall’industria (~2,25 miliardi di tazze al giorno); distribuito per quota di PIL come proxy grezzo del potere d’acquisto.

series.note: Industry estimate; not a measured statistic.

bca.title: Coffee facts – “around 2.25 billion cups of coffee are consumed in the world every day”
